exposure: Controls: Randomly selected postpartum women admitted with other cases
Number of per-vaginal examinations during labor
Cases: Postpartum women admitted with puerperal sepsis
cohort: 305 postpartum women (61 cases & 242 controls) at Hawassa city public hospitals in South Ethiopia from June 17 to August 20, 2021
finding: Cesarean delivery, per-vaginal examination ≥5 times during labor, manual removal of placenta, gestational diabetes mellitus, and prolonged labor were identified as determinants of puerperal sepsis.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a determinant of puerperal sepsis.
